_: What the launcher does with each age-flagged game. Two decisions only: 'excluded' never appears, 'age_gated' appears once the player has confirmed they are 18 or older. A game absent from this file stays hidden until somebody decides, with a source.
_rule: catalog/SCHEMA.md — no field from memory or judgement. Every decision carries the source it rests on.
_excluded_policy: Games whose sexual content IS the product. Not games that are merely violent, dark or unrated — those are gated, not banned.

divinityoriginalsin2._steam_note:
This is a role-playing game in which players assume the role of a hero on a quest to stop an evil called the Void. From a 3/4 overhead perspective, players explore the fantasy world of Rivellon, interact with various characters, and engage in turn-based combat against human enemies and fantastical creatures (e.g., demons, skeletons, giant insects). 

Characters use weapon strikes and magic attacks to defeat enemies in combat; battles are accompanied by blood-splatter effects that stain the surrounding environment. Some areas depict large pools of blood amid human corpses and dismembered limbs. 

The game contains some sexual material: the central character can employ the services of a prostitute at a pub—no sexual activity is depicted, though the dialogue/text makes sexual references (e.g., “Your hand slides all the way up until you reach her, and you make a soft circling motion with your thumb”; “Slowly she undresses you then takes you to bed"; "Your world explodes in bliss."). The word “sh*t” is heard in dialogue.
